County Officials
County Commissioners
The Commissioners oversee the day-to-day business of the county. They also have the authority to adopt ordinances and resolutions, as allowed by Indiana law.
County Council
The seven-member County Council appropriates funds, adopts budgets, fixes tax rates and has exclusive power to borrow money for county use.
Courts and the criminal justice system
CASA Court Appointed Special Advocates
CASA trains and supports community volunteers who serve as Court Appointed Special Advocates for abused and neglected children in the juvenile court system proceedings.
Circuit Courts
The Delaware County Circuit Courts are committed to improving the quality of and access to justice through the projects and programs the courts direct.
Community Corrections
Provides effective, cost-efficient programs for pre and post sentencing options to promote public safety and reduce incarceration.
County Clerk
The County Clerk is an elected county official who serves as both an officer of the court and the custodian of court records and information.
Probation
The Probation Department provide necessary services to offenders to help reduce criminal and delinquent behavior while balancing the needs and safety of the community.
Prosecutor
The Prosecutor’s Office pursues justice within the bounds of the law by holding criminals accountable for their actions and to protect and preserve the rights of victims of crime.
Public Defender’s Office
The Public Defender’s Office provides constitutionally mandated legal representation to individuals who are financially unable to retain private counsel.
Public safety
Sheriff’s Office
The members of the Delaware County Sheriff’s Office are dedicated to serving the law enforcement needs of the community in which we work and live.
Emergency Management
The Delaware County Emergency Management Agency (EMA) works to protect lives, property, and critical infrastructure through planning, coordination, and emergency response.
911 Communications Center
The Delaware County 911 Emergency Communications Center (E911) operates 24/7 answering all 911 emergency calls and non-emergency calls and routing first responders to incident locations.
EMS
Delaware County EMS delivers comprehensive advanced life support (ALS) transport and intercept services across the region.
Coroner
Delaware County Coroner’s Office is to provide the residents of Delaware County with a professional, respectful, and compassionate investigation into every death that occurs within the county’s legal jurisdiction.
Health Department
The Delaware County Health Department strives to promote a healthy community by providing essential resources and services to keep our community safe and healthy.
Property, taxes and official documents
Assessor
The Delaware County Assessor’s Office is responsible for assessing all real and personal property in the county.
Auditor
The Auditor’s Office is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, protecting taxpayer resources, administering property tax systems, and ensuring transparency and accountability throughout county government.
Building Commissioner and Code Enforcement
The Delaware County Building Commissioner’s Office issues permits for projects located in the unincorporated areas of Delaware County, Indiana, as well as enforcing the building code.
Delaware-Muncie Metropolitan Plan Commission
The Delaware-Muncie Metropolitan Plan Commission Metropolitan Planning Organization coordinates regional transportation and transit planning to support economic growth, environmental sustainability, and high-quality residential and commercial development that benefits the greater Muncie community.
Office of Information & GIS Services
The Delaware County Office of Information and GIS Services manages the County’s Geographic Information System (GIS) and serves as the central point of contact for Delaware County’s web-based applications and mapping services.
Recorder
The County Recorder’s Office catalogs and makes available all important public documents.
Treasurer
The County Treasurer is responsible for collecting county taxes, other taxes required by state law, and special assessments.
Roads, bridges and infrastructure
Stormwater Board
The County Stormwater Board is responsible for overseeing stormwater management, drainage infrastructure, flood prevention, and compliance with Indiana’s Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4) requirements.
Regional Wastewater District
Delaware County Regional Wastewater District (DCRWD) serves the unincorporated areas in Delaware County, insuring clean, quality sewer services.
Weights and Measures
The County Weights and Measures Department helps ensure fairness in buying and selling goods. The department tests and inspects commercial measuring devices to make sure they are accurate and meet state standards.
County Engineering Department
The County Engineering Department is responsible for managing public works projects including bridges, roadways and other infrastructure.
Highway Department
The Highway Department is responsible for maintaining roads and bridges within Delaware County.
County Surveyor
The County Surveyor duties include managing the county's regulated drains to ensure proper drainage and maintaining land section corner monumentation for surveying purposes.
Delaware County Redevelopment Commission
The County Redevelopment Commission is responsible for promoting economic growth, community improvement, and responsible land redevelopment throughout the county.
General services
Delaware County Fairgrounds
The Delaware County Fairgrounds not only serves as the home for the annual county fair, but for various events and community activities throughout the year.
Human Resources
The Human Resources Department promotes an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing workforce by providing responsive human resources services, fostering positive employee relations, and advancing fairness, respect, and opportunity throughout county government
Purdue Extension Office
Purdue Extension-Delaware County offers programs in Agriculture, Health and Human Sciences, 4-H & Youth Development and Economic Community Development.
Veterans’ Service Office
The County Veterans Service Office provides free, expert advocacy to help local veterans, military personnel, and their families successfully navigate and secure the federal, state, and local benefits they have rightfully earned.
